scope: Literal standalone public MetadataTable overflow wrapper/table/header/cell class declarations and saved public metadata-test table-selection/stub boundaries only

testSourcesReadNotExecuted.coverage: Public declaration selection omits MetadataTable; props-only metadata-table stub. Saved one-row ID assertions inspect supplied row props, not wrapper/table/td classes or actual long metadata layout.

Table omitted from selected declarations and substituted with a string placeholder. Only table selection/stub boundary evaluated; adjacent form/callback source incidental. No overflow/wrapping/layout qualification.

sourceDecision: Retain production. Literal public MetadataTable outer div declares overflow-x-auto rounded-lg border border-zinc-800; the table declares w-full text-sm. Column headers declare whitespace-nowrap px-3 py-3 text-left. Each ordered metadata td declares max-w-md break-all px-3 py-2, with the exact row[item.key] direct child; conditional action td declares px-3 py-2 without those metadata width/break classes. These class strings do not prove computed dimensions, actual overflow/scrolling/clipping/wrapping, long-string presentation, zoom or accessibility. Saved metadata tests omit the real table and cannot qualify its layout. No concrete supported correction compatible with frozen expectations was established.
